Spellshape @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Widen Spell]

Firmware Enhancement You become trained in medium armor. Whenever you increase your proficiency with light armor, you also increase your proficiency with medium armor.

Overclock Boost (tech armor) The first time each round that each hostile creature damages you, it takes force damage equal to half your level rounded up.

Overclock Pulse—Overclock Armor a (flourish) Requirements You’re wearing overclocked tech armor; Effect Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +2 status bonus to AC, and you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level rounded up.

Basic Jailbreak (3rd)—Safety Protocol When you use Jailbreak Spell to apply @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Widen Spell] to a spell, you can use surplus energy to move in any direction, up to 5 feet per rank of the spell. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions. You determine the origin of the spell and its area before you move, but you move before the spell takes effect; if this ability moves you out of the spell’s area, you take no effects dependent on being in the spell’s area (such as damage from fireball). You’re otherwise affected normally.

Advanced Jailbreak (8th)—Denial of Safety When you use Jailbreak Spell to apply Widen Spell to a spell, add an additional 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet or the length of a cone or line that’s normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add an additional 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.
